items: 【Triple Mode Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo】Connect up to 5 devices via 2.4GHz, Bluetooth 1/2/3 or type-c cable. Easily connect multiple devices with just one keyboard and mouse set.

【Rechargeable Keyboard and Mouse】Built-in rechargeable battery helps you save on battery costs while being eco-friendly. The keyboard lasts up to 200 hours and the mouse up to 50 hours on a full charge (backlight off). When the keyboard or mouse battery is low, a red light will flash slowly to remind you to recharge.

【Creamy Keyboard with Number Pad】Mac and Windows two-system layout, thocky keyboard with number pad and knob, ideal for both work and entertainment. The mouse supports 800/1200/1600/2400 DPI for precise control.

【Universal Compatibility】This Bluetooth wireless keyboard and mouse combo works with Windows 7/8/10/11, iOS, Mac and Android systems. Compatible with desktops, laptops, MacBooks, tablets, iPads, and smartphones.

【Light Up Computer Keyboard & Mouse Combo】The wireless keyboard features 14 RGB lighting effects and the mouse offers 12, brightness and lighting speed can be adjusted directly on the device. Adding vibrant style to your workspace or gaming setup.
【Ergonomic Design】Scientific key layout with a foldable stand allows you to type at a more comfortable angle, reducing wrist strain during long hours of use.
